description: This Java source file defines the class AskGestureEventsListener, which implements gesture event handling for a custom keyboard view, including scroll, fling, pinch, and other gesture detection methods.

classes.name: AskGestureEventsListener
classes.description: A final class implementing gesture event handling for the keyboard view, including scroll, fling, pinch, and other gesture detection methods.

methods.name: AskGestureEventsListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener with a reference to the keyboard view.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll gestures, detecting direction and velocity, and triggers swipe actions if thresholds are exceeded.

methods.name: getPointerDirection
methods.description: Determines the direction of a pointer movement between two MotionEvent instances.

methods.name: pointersMovingInTheSameDirection
methods.description: Checks if all pointers are moving in the same direction during a multi-touch gesture.

methods.name: onFling
methods.description: Handles fling gestures, detecting swipe directions and triggering corresponding actions.

methods.name: onPinch
methods.description: Handles pinch gestures, triggering actions when the pinch factor is below a threshold.

methods.name: onSeparate
methods.description: Handles separate gestures, triggering actions when the separation factor exceeds a threshold.

methods.name: onDown
methods.description: Handles the down event; currently returns false.

methods.name: onLongPress
methods.description: Handles long press events; currently does nothing.

methods.name: onShowPress
methods.description: Handles show press events; currently does nothing.

methods.name: onSingleTapUp
methods.description: Handles single tap up events; currently returns false.
